## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
The repository configuration in pyproject.toml defines ruff exclusion rules via extend-exclude = ["research-program/artifacts"] at line 64, but tool.black at lines 102-105 lacks an equivalent exclusion rule. Consequently, running black --check . evaluates machine-generated, unformatted Python scripts published under research-program/artifacts (such as research-program/artifacts/audits/Fine-Art-Archive-2026-09-05-resume/finalize.py). This causes CI formatting checks in Python CI / lint-format to fail on main with exit code 1. Adding extend-exclude = 'research-program/artifacts' under tool.black ensures that published research artifacts do not trigger false-positive CI format gate failures.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [x] `black --check .` executes and passes with exit code 0 on the repository root.
- [x] `pytest tests/test_repo_hygiene.py` passes all assertions.
- [x] Deliberate-break demonstration: removing extend-exclude from tool.black in pyproject.toml causes `black --check .` to fail with exit code 1 when unformatted artifact files exist, and reverting restores pass.
